<style>
body, html {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  height: 100%;
  width: 100%;
  background-image: url('MainMenuPageEditorBackground.png');
  background-size: cover;
  background-position: center;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
}

#main-container {
  text-align: center;
}

#title {
  background-color: #00c0e4;
  color: white;
  font-size: 40px;
  font-weight: bold;
  padding: 20px 40px;
  border-radius: 40px;
  margin-bottom: 30px;
}

.button {
  display: block;
  background-color: #00c0e4;
  color: white;
  font-size: 20px;
  padding: 15px 50px;
  margin: 10px auto;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 40px;
  cursor: pointer;
  width: 240px;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.button:hover {
  background-color: #0099b8;
}

#how-to-use-popup {
  display: none;
  position: fixed;
  top: 10%;
  left: 50%;
  transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 400px;
  background-color: #00c0e4;
  padding: 20px;
  border-radius: 30px;
  color: white;
  z-index: 10;
}

#how-to-use-popup h2 {
  background-color: #008fb8;
  padding: 10px 20px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  display: inline-block;
  margin-top: 0;
}

#close-btn {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  right: 20px;
  font-size: 20px;
  cursor: pointer;
  background: #008fb8;
  border-radius: 50%;
  padding: 5px 10px;
}

.instruction-box {
  background-color: #008fb8;
  border-radius: 15px;
  padding: 10px;
  margin: 10px 0;
}
</style>

<div id="main-container">
  <div id="title">I SPY GAME CREATOR</div>
  <button class="button" onclick="createGame()">Create Game</button>
  <button class="button" onclick="showHowTo()">How to Use</button>
</div>

<div id="how-to-use-popup" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="howToTitle" style="position: fixed; top: 12%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 420px; max-width: 90vw; background-color: #00a1d6; padding: 30px 25px 25px 25px; border-radius: 20px; color: white; z-index: 10000; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 88, 131, 0.5); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;">
  <div id="close-btn" role="button" aria-label="Close help popup" tabindex="0" onclick="closeHowTo()" style="position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 18px; font-size: 22px; cursor: pointer; background: #0081bc; border-radius: 50%; width: 34px; height: 34px; line-height: 34px; text-align: center; color: #cce7f7; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 80, 114, 0.8); transition: background-color 0.3s ease;">✖</div>
  <h2 id="howToTitle" style="background-color: #0074a2; padding: 14px 24px; border-radius: 15px; margin: 0 0 20px 0; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 103, 142, 0.8);">
    How to use
  </h2>
  <div class="instruction-box" style="background-color: #008dcf; border-radius: 15px; padding: 16px 20px; margin-bottom: 18px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 108, 150, 0.7); color: white; font-weight: 500;"> To add a background, click on the image icon.<br>
    To add images, click on the easel icon.<br>
    To add textboxes, click on the speech bubble icon.<br>
    To add music, click on the note icon.<br>
    To add clickable buttons, click on the arrow icon.<br>
    To download the game, click on the download icon.
  </div>
  <div class="instruction-box" style="background-color: #008dcf; border-radius: 15px; padding: 16px 20px; margin-bottom: 0; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(0, 108, 150, 0.7); color: white; font-weight: 500;"> To move images, boxes, and more, press <strong>M</strong>.<br>
    To rotate, press <strong>R</strong>.<br>
    To scale, press <strong>S</strong>.<br>
    To link images to textboxes, press <strong>L</strong> while both are selected.
  </div>
</div>

<script>
function createGame() {
  window.location.href = 'editor.html'; // ✅ Redirect to editor.html
}

function showHowTo() {
  document.getElementById('how-to-use-popup').style.display = 'block';
}

function closeHowTo() {
  document.getElementById('how-to-use-popup').style.display = 'none';
}
</script>
